title: Local switchless-ring DeepSeek V4.1 Flash decode benchmark

reference.repeatProtocol: two discarded prose c1 warmups; c1 median of 3; c4 median of 2; c2/c8/c16 one run each

notes: Live dashboard and all four model ranks were healthy before measurement.
All four ranks use NET/IB and the request-smoke snapshot showed positive TX/RX RDMA counter deltas on every node.
README reference used switched RoCE; this run retains the local physical ring.
No SparkDash-managed GPU clock cap was detected (capMHz=null); no host clock settings were changed.
